claim_boundary.claim_if_grey: SAE-derived features show suggestive structure, but the result is underpowered, text-explained, unstable across controls, or not reliably above baseline.
claim_boundary.claim_if_null: The Stage 7 Foundation readout remains real, but this SAE configuration did not recover sparse CAS-aligned features beyond controls.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: In this first pilot, SAE-derived features provide a bounded, inspectable feature basis from which CAS Foundation signals are recoverable above pre-registered baselines on the tested model, layer, fixture, and held-out split.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass_with_ablation: If targeted SAE-feature removal clears the causal gate, CAS Harness may also claim readout-level causal relevance of the selected feature set under controls.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim exact causal neurons, true CAS neurons, model thoughts, a complete neuron-by-neuron causal map, generated-language steering, raw CAS-symbol understanding, an internal CAS compiler, solved black-box interpretability, or generalization to arbitrary models/tasks/frontier scale.

gates.criterion: top SAE decoder features align to Stage 7 Foundation probe directions above matched random decoder-vector controls, empirical p < 0.05
gates.name: cas_alignment

gates.criterion: CAS-aligned features show heldout class-selective activation; top-class mean activation exceeds random feature controls, empirical p < 0.05
gates.name: feature_specificity

gates.criterion: removing top CAS-aligned SAE feature contributions degrades Stage 7 Foundation probe accuracy more than matched random feature removals
gates.name: causal_feature_drop

motivation: Stage 24A/24B static sonar detected broad token geometry but failed hard local contrasts. This suggests polysemantic readout directions and motivates SAE feature decomposition.
